scope.protocol: pinned full source; four layer-major plus four non-layer-major arms

conclusion: The fixed full protocol schedules 100 generation HTTP calls, not 96. The earlier 96 metadata modeled every arm as 12 calls and omitted the second cold_eq case in each of four non-layer-major arms.

retry1_adapter.binding: sets the base runner SCR to t16_frozen_helpers_v1 before CandidateRunner executes the full protocol

ready_sayok.reason: Runner.ready sends one POST /v1/chat/completions after health polling; health GET is not a generation call.

cold_eq.reason: The frozen cold_eq.main contains one urllib.request.urlopen POST. run_arm invokes it once per selected case; check_det rereads output files and sends no request.

probe_ft_cold32k.reason: cold_eq imports only build_text, MODEL, MODEL_DIR, and URL from probe_ft_cold32k; it never invokes probe_ft_cold32k.main. The latter's own one-urlopen main is therefore not on the cold_eq execution path.

checkpoint_tax.reason: ft_probe_ckpt_tax.main calls first_real(single) and first_real(multi) in each of REPS=5 iterations; first_real issues one streaming POST.

protocol_formula.layer_major_calls_per_arm: 1 ready + 1 cold_eq case + 5*(1 single + 1 multi) tax = 12
protocol_formula.non_layer_major_calls_per_arm: 1 ready + 2 cold_eq cases (short, chunked) + 5*(1 single + 1 multi) tax = 13

records_requiring_root_addendum.incorrect_source_metadata: user-scope expected planned_generation_calls=96 and CPU filedry's eight-times-12 mock

required_correction_semantics.instruction: Root must append a count-correction addendum that binds this review and leaves all earlier source, scope, and CPU filedry bytes unchanged. The addendum corrects metadata only; it must not reduce, expand, or rerun the fixed protocol.

limitations: This review is static, read-only source accounting. It does not establish completed measurement calls or product acceptance.
D09 retry1 was active during review; current GPU occupancy, process state, service endpoints, and global lock state were intentionally not inspected.
The count includes generation HTTP POSTs only. Health polling and local artifact comparisons are excluded.
